cli.common.instance_option: Instance root; defaults to searching upward for akaribot.toml, or the AKARI_INSTANCE_DIR variable
cli.common.lang_option: UI language, e.g. zh_cn / en_us; defaults to AKARIBOT_LANG, the instance config, then the system locale
cli.common.table_option: Config table name, e.g. module_wiki, bot_telegram
cli.error.not_instance: Not an AkariBot instance (akaribot.toml not found). Run `akaribot init` first, or pass `--instance <root>` / set AKARI_INSTANCE_DIR.
cli.warn.instance_not_running_load: The instance is not running, so it cannot be loaded now; it will load on the next start. Run `akaribot run` first to apply immediately.
cli.warn.instance_not_running_unload: The instance is not running, so it cannot be unloaded now; the next start will still load it per module_status. Run `akaribot run` first to keep it unloaded.
